summary: Iteration 135 Testing Complete - WebRTC Perfect Negotiation + Meeting Chat verified. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: Chat in video call works, AlertDialog for force-logout-all works. WebRTC 3+ participant test requires real browser contexts with camera permissions which cannot be fully simulated in Playwright automation.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps with chat send button - requires force=True to click

bug_a_webrtc_3plus_participants.status: CODE VERIFIED - Cannot fully E2E test
bug_a_webrtc_3plus_participants.details: LiveMeetingPage.js implements Perfect Negotiation pattern (iter 135): createPeer() returns {pc, polite, makingOffer, ignoreOffer, pendingCandidates}. Polite peer determined by user_id comparison. Offer handler (lines 382-422) implements rollback for glare. ICE candidates queued if remoteDescription not set (lines 440-453). Auto ICE restart on failure (lines 326-329). Full 3-browser-context test requires real camera/microphone permissions which Playwright cannot grant in headless mode.
bug_a_webrtc_3plus_participants.code_review: Perfect Negotiation implementation looks correct. Key fixes: (1) Deterministic polite/impolite roles, (2) pendingCandidates queue flushed after setRemoteDescription, (3) Rollback for offer collision, (4) ICE auto-restart on failure.

bug_b_chat_in_video_call.details: Chat panel opens via toggle-chat-button, messages can be sent via Enter key or send-chat-button (with force=True due to badge overlay), messages appear in chat panel with user name and timestamp. Backend POST /api/meetings/{id}/chat stores messages, GET returns history sorted by created_at.

bug_c_chat_stress_50_messages.details: Backend test sent 50 messages alternating between admin and testuser2. All messages persisted and retrieved in chronological order. Special characters (emojis, HTML, unicode, long strings) handled correctly.

regression_iter134_alertdialog.details: Admin > Nutzer tab > 'Alle abmelden' button opens AlertDialog with 'Abbrechen' and 'Ja, alle abmelden' buttons. Dialog explains that all active users except current admin will be logged out.

regression_iter134_chat_unread.details: GET /api/chat/unread-summary endpoint returns 200 with unread count data.

backend_api_tests.details: 16/16 pytest tests passed: auth (2), meeting CRUD (2), meeting chat (4), chat stress (3), meeting participants (3), regression iter134 (2)

frontend_ui_tests.details: Login works, meetings page loads, instant meeting creation works, pre-join page works, live meeting page loads with controls, chat panel opens and messages can be sent, admin page loads with Users tab and Force Logout All AlertDialog.

action_items: WebRTC 3+ participant bug (Bug A): Code review confirms Perfect Negotiation implementation is correct. Real-world testing with 3+ users joining same meeting recommended to verify fix works in production.
Minor: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps chat send button in live meeting - consider adjusting z-index or position
critical_code_review_comments: LiveMeetingPage.js Perfect Negotiation implementation (iter 135) follows WebRTC spec correctly: polite peer determined by user_id comparison, offer collision handled with rollback, ICE candidates queued until remoteDescription set
ChatPanel.js correctly renders messages with message_id || i as key, handles user_name || sender fallback
Backend websocket.py broadcasts chat messages excluding sender (line 86), sender sees own message via local setChatMessages in frontend
Backend meetings/core.py POST /meetings/{id}/chat stores message with user_id, user_name, avatar, message, created_at
seed_data_creation: Test meetings created with TEST_ prefix during pytest execution, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 135 WebRTC Perfect Negotiation fix verified via code review. Chat in video call works correctly - messages sent via Enter key or send button appear in chat panel. 50-message stress test passed. AlertDialog for force-logout-all (iter 134) still works. For full WebRTC 3+ participant E2E test, need real browser contexts with camera/microphone permissions - Playwright headless cannot fully simulate this. Recommend manual testing with 3 users in production environment.

webrtc_perfect_negotiation_code_review.createPeer_function: Lines 305-332 - Creates RTCPeerConnection with ICE config, determines polite role by user_id comparison, stores {pc, polite, makingOffer, ignoreOffer, pendingCandidates} in peersRef
webrtc_perfect_negotiation_code_review.offer_handler: Lines 382-422 - Implements Perfect Negotiation: detects offer collision, impolite peer ignores colliding offers, polite peer rolls back own offer and accepts incoming
webrtc_perfect_negotiation_code_review.answer_handler: Lines 423-439 - Sets remote description, flushes pending ICE candidates
webrtc_perfect_negotiation_code_review.ice_candidate_handler: Lines 440-453 - Queues candidates if remoteDescription not set, adds immediately otherwise
webrtc_perfect_negotiation_code_review.verdict: Implementation follows WebRTC Perfect Negotiation spec correctly. Should fix 3+ participant video call issue.
